contributions.detail: 5 inked rows sum to 100.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 80.00 + 2983.08 = 3363.08. That equals Box F (Subtotal Before Expenditures = Box A + Box B) 3,363.08 EXACTLY, and equals Box B 2983.08 + Box C 380.00 exactly. It does NOT equal the amended Schedule A figures: both 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' were originally 380.00 (the four black-ink rows) and were struck through in green and rewritten as 2983.08 (the one green-ink row) - the amendment REPLACED the total with the added row instead of adding to it, dropping the 380.00 already itemized. CAUSE TRACED, and it is the FILER's arithmetic: the same green pen also entered Box B = 2983.08 (this period) and left Box C = 380.00 (year-to-date), a split that is internally inconsistent (YTD below this-period) but sums to the correct 3,363.08 the filer then wrote in Box F and matched against expenditures. Per the contract this side is published verbatim as a delta with needs_review on every row; the row VALUES themselves are not in doubt - each was re-read at 600 dpi and the five of them close to Box F to the cent. Scope: Box A = 0 and this is the first report of the 2024 cycle (cover annotation 'Financial Report for Primary election', dated 6-18-24), so period and cycle-to-date coincide for the report as a whole - recorded cumulative.

expenditures.detail: 5 emitted rows sum to 170.00 + 600.00 + 294.98 + 35.00 + 2263.10 = 3363.08, exactly the printed 'Subtotal for this page' 3363.08, 'Total Expenditures Made' 3363.08, Box D (this period) and Box E (year-to-date). Box D == Box E so period and YTD coincide; scope cumulative. NOTE on row 5: the filer braced SIX dates (1-23, 3-05, 4-30, 5-01, 5-09, 5-10 of 2024) to a single vendor 'Square One Printing' and gave ONE boxed amount, 'Square One Total: $2,263.10'. The form presents one amount, so ONE row is emitted with a blank date; splitting it into six would fabricate six amounts the document does not carry.
